Family dinner at my fave honey ribs spot 🥹
Sep 2026 • Family
Food was pretty decent imo!

My friend Lindsay rcm’d this place to me after her trip, so I finally got the chance to try it myself. First thing I gotta give them credit for is the decor — it’s sooo nice + honestly such a good vibe for a lil dinner w/ my fam.

2nd compliment goes to the food. Everything I ordered was pretty easy to eat + totally my kinda food. The honey ribs were sooo good tho!! 😭 My mom was also a big fan of the lobster, and my dad said the wine was pretty good too. I don’t really know much abt wine tho, so I have no idea what kind it was 😭

Last but not least, the service! There was this guy serving us named Hoang, and he was rlly attentive + super nice the whole time. Big shoutout to him fr. If I ever come back, I’d def love to have him serve us again!!
